**Raymond Brown**  
Hiring Manager  
NSW Department of Communities and Justice  
Parramatta NSW, Australia  

Dear Mr. Brown,

I am writing to express my interest in the Test Manager position with the NSW Department of Communities and Justice (DCJ). With over 19 years of quality engineering and test leadership experience—encompassing large-scale platform migrations, enterprise test governance, and previous public-sector delivery for Transport for NSW—I welcome the opportunity to establish robust, risk-based testing frameworks that safeguard critical public services and support meaningful community outcomes.

Throughout my career, I have defined end-to-end quality strategies, directed defect triage, and implemented strict quality gates for mission-critical enterprise systems. As QA Lead at Avant Mutual, I directed the quality assurance team through an enterprise migration from a legacy LAMP stack to a modern cloud-native .NET and React platform. In this role, I established testing governance, led daily defect triage sessions with development and business leads, validated data integrity, and oversaw cross-functional release management to provide objective recommendations on go-live readiness. Similarly, at Wpay (Woolworths Group), I formulated comprehensive test strategies, documentation, and pilot programs to validate architecture and failure modes prior to mass rollout, while engineering Azure DevOps pipelines to automate regression testing and embed static security analysis.

I bring a collaborative leadership style and extensive experience navigating competing priorities among business stakeholders, multidisciplinary delivery teams, and external partners. Functioning in dual Business Analyst and QA capacities, I have translated complex operational requirements into clear testable criteria while uplifting automated regression suites using modern tooling. Furthermore, my foundational work with Cubic Transportation Systems supporting the Transport for NSW Opal Travel platform provided firsthand appreciation of the testing rigour required for public-facing services. Backed by a Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, an ISTQB Foundation certification, and Scrum Master credentials, I am equipped to lead risk-based test management, coach practitioners, and assure delivery across DCJ's initiatives.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my quality leadership, governance background, and delivery experience align with the goals of the Department of Communities and Justice. Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,  

**Anoop Sinkaran**
